title: Wisdom and personalized application
body:
Kylie Kelly is the real deal as a business owner. She shares wisdom about email growth and the context so you can apply it to your personal business. 

Great advice that you don’t know how to put into practice is useless. Thank you for serving in this way.
name: Adriana Watt

title: Realistic & Effective
body: Kylie is an incredible resource for anyone looking to organically grow their email community! She provides a variety of different strategies, which I love because what works for one audience might not work for another. Kylie is very approachable & willing to share her knowledge to help others grow & succeed!
name: Wellness with Vanda

title: The best resource on organic list growth ~ hands down!
body: Kylie is so good at helping you build your email list with ideal clients using relationship~centered growth strategies!! Everything she teaches she also does herself so she’s in this with you & can support you in building your list and growing your business organically! Love her show !!!
name: jennyroth22

title: Full of actionable email list building tips (without using social media!)
body: The Email Growth Show is a must-listen for women entrepreneurs! Kylie gives email marketing tips that are actionable and shows us how we can build our email lists in a fun and easier way - without having to rely on social media. She breaks down strategies that she herself has used that we can also implement and makes growing an email list feel manageable!
name: Freedom achiever

title: Finally an easy to digest podcast on email marketing!
body: I love how simple she makes email marketing! The episodes are packed with actionable tips! Cant wait to see how my list grows when I implement Kylie’s strategies!
name: Ashleigh Foy

title: So good! Especially if you’re over social media!
body: I love Kylie’s framework and mindset around growing an email list and taking pressure off social media platforms and tactics to build a community. Email is so important for business growth and Kylie’s down to earth approach and helpful strategies make this podcast so actionable! A must listen for business owners - especially if you’re sick of socials
name: frustratedcontentcreator

title: No-fluff advice that actually works
body: Kylie is so down to earth and engaging, I’m loving this podcast so far! The idea of buying a bunch of ads and pandering to the social media gods had me stuck but Kylie’s email strategies are giving me quick wins already despite starting from zero as an introvert.
name: Booktart

title: Honest & Informative
body:
Kylie is a rare find in this online business world.  A smart, savvy and strategic business leader who has a knack for breaking things down and making growing your email list easy!

Love her honesty and realness - even with her own journey!

A must listen for online busines owners!
name: LovingOps
